profile.headline: Software Developer Engineer III at Workday

positions.title: Full-stack Developer/Advanced Degree Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on projects related to Natural Language Processing and Supervised Learning.
-Contributed to projects using data cleaning/data display frameworks such as Bokeh, Matplotlib, Pandas and Numpy.
-Applied knowledge of Machine Learning on Back-End using python. 
- Front-End programming with React.js, Vanilla js, HTML and CSS.
-Back-End programming with Python Flask.

positions.title: Web-Assistant
positions.description:
•Changed Menu structure of UC Merced Housing website and added new content to it, using HTML, CSS and Bootstrap.
•Created scalable quiz application where users answer questions and are guided to a certain outcome, using React.js, HTML, CSS, Bulma, JavaScript DOM Manipulation, RESTful APIs, Python, and SQLite3.
•Assist in improving the looks of any campus website, with the goal to create a more user-friendly interface

company.name: Media Cats, UC Merced Marketing Communications For Enrollment Management

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
•Worked under the supervision of Professor Angelo Kyrilov at UC Merced.
•Helped develop website that will be used for teaching and grading students in selected CS courses at UC Merced. Website will include a C++ compiler with code and lecture slides that come from a python server using RESTful APIs, all with the goal to create a learning environment for students.  
•Working on educational website for students learning C++ with the goal to facilitate their learning.
•Built with HTML, CSS, JS, Vue.js, Node.js, SQL, and other frameworks/Libraries like Bulma, Semantic UI, jQuery and Axios.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
•Tutor students in Java, C/C++ (data structures and algorithms), and Computer Architecture.	
•Encourage students to be more involved in school activities to improve their academic success.
•Host review sessions for 15-30 students at a time to prepare them for their upcoming exams.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Worked on HackMerced website with a team of 10 people, for the 2019 spring Hackathon at UC Merced.
•Website features a log in page for administrators and participants. Used Node.js, HTML, CSS, React.js, and Semantic UI.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Updated 4 different school websites with new content, using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
• Assisted on updating 2 websites to have a better User Interface, using Drupal, CSS and HTML.
